__prompts__.project_name: project_name - The name of your project (example: organization-git-author-stats)
__prompts__.token_environment_variable: token_environment_variable - The name of an environment variable that contains your GitHub developer token, if needed (example: GITHUB_PASSWORD)
__prompts__.repository_url: repository_url - The URL of the Git repository or organization (examples: github.com/organization or github.com/organization/organization-git-author-stats)
__prompts__.weeks_of_history: weeks_of_history - The number of weeks of commit history to evaluate during the initial run (default: 56, which is 1 year)
__prompts__.weeks_until_commit_is_stale: weeks_until_commit_is_stale - The maximum number of weeks a pull request can be open before it is considered stale (default: 4)
